basic_iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
basic_iron_sword.description: A standard three-foot blade. The weapon of a gentleman, but often wielded by scoundrels.

jade_sword.name: Jade Frost Sword
jade_sword.description: A rare sword with a blade that faintly glows. Said to have been forged in a glacier. Conducts Qi beautifully.

ghost_blade.name: Ghost Edge Sword
ghost_blade.description: A narrow, dark blade said to carry the chill of the underworld. Favoured by shadow cults.

golden_light_sword.name: Golden Light Sword
golden_light_sword.description: A ceremonial blade forged from refined bronze and inlaid with gold. More symbol than weapon — until it isn't.
